title: 第14章 抱一下，暴击
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一道道淡金色的光芒，绚丽夺目。

光芒从蛇躯和蜘蛛残骸内部透出来，像是有什么东西正在从内部往外燃烧。

很快，尸体开始变得透明，被某种不可思议的力量分解成无数细小的光粒。

光粒像萤火虫一样凝聚，形成一个个光团，散落下来。

光团逐渐收敛，里面出现一件件战利品。

巨蛇蛇肉，蜘蛛甲壳……

秦守看着眼前的景象，心中浮现怪异的感觉。

太像打游戏了！

打败boss后，Boss的尸体消失，爆出一堆战利品。

哎，对啊，地铁生存游戏，本来就是一场游戏。

出现这种情况，也很合理！

秦守在心中摇了摇头，把这些乱七八糟的念头甩到脑后。

地铁车厢方向，突然传来巨大的广播声。

【恭喜玩家秦守，成功击杀原始森林站台精英怪「远古巨蛇」】

紧接着又响了第二遍。

这次不仅在车厢内，同时在聊天频道里以系统公告的形式弹出。

一行橙色的加粗文字置顶刷过整个聊天频道。

【区域公告：玩家秦守成功击杀精英级怪物「远古巨蛇」，为本站台首杀，特此通报表扬，并且奖励「特殊蓝图宝箱」×1】

聊天频道凝固了整整三秒，然后像被泼了冷水的滚油一样炸开。

【首杀？！我们躲在地铁车厢内瑟瑟发抖，大佬已经拿首杀了？！】

【秦守大佬牛哔——破音！】

【大佬求带！求攻略！求包养！求一切！】

【秦守大佬，我们姐妹五人专程去樱国进修过，精通多位老师的成名绝技，求你给我们一个机会，包你满意！】

玩家们一个个花式吹捧，希望得到秦守大佬的关照。

秦守此刻根本不在老式电脑前，他不知道聊天频道里的消息，他的注意力都放在了系统奖励的「特殊蓝图宝箱」上。

一个闪烁着蓝色光泽的宝箱，出现在秦守面前。

秦守上前

一道蓝色光芒升腾而起，同时伴随着三道浓郁的绿色光芒。

凌云走过来，定睛看去。

只见宝箱里一共有四张蓝图，一张蓝色品质，三张绿色品质。

她拿起蓝色品质的蓝图。

【一阶蓝色制造蓝图·巨蛇毒吻】

【类型：饰品】

【效果一：佩戴者可抵御初级毒性伤害。】

【效果二：释放微弱威压，震慑周边低级远古生物，降低遭遇袭击概率。】

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

The rays of pale golden light are dazzling.

Light shone from the inside of the snake body and spider remains, as if something was burning from the inside out.

Soon, the corpse began to become transparent and was broken down into countless tiny light particles by some incredible force.

The light particles condensed like fireflies, forming light clusters and scattered down.

The light group gradually converged, and pieces of loot appeared inside.

Giant snake meat, spider carapace...

Qin Shou looked at the scene in front of him and felt a strange feeling in his heart.

It’s so much like playing a game!

After defeating the boss, the boss's body disappears, revealing a pile of loot.

Hey, yes, the subway survival game is originally a game.

It is quite reasonable for this situation to occur!

Qin Shou shook his head in his heart and threw these messy thoughts to the back of his mind.

A loud announcement suddenly came from the direction of the subway car.

[Congratulations to player Qin Shou for successfully killing the elite monster "Ancient Giant Snake" on the virgin forest platform]

Then it rang a second time.

This time it popped up not only in the car, but also in the chat channel in the form of a system announcement.

A line of orange bold text was placed at the top of the chat channel.

[Regional Announcement: Player Qin Shou successfully killed the elite monster "Ancient Giant Snake", which was the first kill on this platform. We hereby report the praise and reward "Special Blueprint Treasure Box" × 1]

The chat channel froze for a full three seconds, and then exploded like boiling oil poured with cold water.

[First kill?!We were hiding in the subway car and shivering. The boss had already killed us?!】

[Big Brother Qin Shou Niubi - broken sound!】

[Boss, please take me with you!Please give me a guide!Please support me!Ask for everything!】

[Boss Qin Shou, the five of us sisters have made a special trip to Yingguo to study, and are proficient in the famous skills of many teachers. Please give us a chance, and I guarantee your satisfaction!】

The players all flattered in various ways, hoping to get the attention of Mr. Qin Shou.

Qin Shou was not in front of the old-fashioned computer at the moment. He didn't know the news in the chat channel. His attention was focused on the "Special Blueprint Treasure Box" rewarded by the system.

A treasure box with blue luster appeared in front of Qin Shou.

Qin Shou stepped forward

A blue light rose up, accompanied by three rich green lights.

Ling Yun came over and looked intently.

I saw a total of four blueprints in the treasure chest, one blue quality and three green quality.

She picked up the blue quality blueprint.

[First-order blue manufacturing blueprint·Giant snake’s venomous kiss]

[Type: Accessories]

[Effect 1: The wearer can resist primary toxic damage.】

[Effect 2: Release weak coercion, frighten surrounding low-level ancient creatures, and reduce the probability of encountering attacks.】
